title: Group by Extension
prompt: Implement by_suffix(paths) returning a dict mapping suffix (including the dot, lowercase) to a sorted list of path names. Files without a suffix go under ''.

tests.name: groups by suffix
tests.code:
ps = [Path('a.txt'), Path('b.py'), Path('c.txt')]
assert by_suffix(ps) == {'.py': ['b.py'], '.txt': ['a.txt', 'c.txt']}
ps2 = [Path('b.txt'), Path('D.TXT')]
assert by_suffix(ps2)['.txt'] == ['D.TXT', 'b.txt'], 'suffix keys are lowercase and names come out sorted'
tests.hint: Group by p.suffix; sort each list.

tests.name: no suffix bucket
tests.hint: p.suffix is '' when there is no extension.
